messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand your frustration, but don't worry—we're making progress. Since you have good signal and data, the next most common cause for MMS issues is incorrect APN settings (specifically the MMSC URL, which is required for MMS).

Let's check your APN settings. Please use the `check_apn_settings` action on your device and let me know what it shows for the APN name and MMSC URL.

This check is safe and won't affect any of your data.

My current APN name is "internet," but the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. What does this mean? Will fixing this help me send MMS? I'm worried about making a mistake.

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
